_note: Hand-written example responses for cases/mcp-filesystem, written by us to show the format. They are not output from any model and were not produced by a real filesystem server. Seven pass. Three fail on purpose, one in each direction: mcpfs-002 deletes a file the user only asked to read (called when it should not have), mcpfs-006 asks for confirmation instead of deleting when the user clearly asked (did not call when it should have), and mcpfs-007 URL-encodes the path (wrong call).
